holdshield.config.title: Hold Shield Settings
holdshield.config.enabled.tooltip: Turns the shield key on or off.
holdshield.config.activation.hold.toolti: The shield is raised while you hold the key (default).
holdshield.config.activation.toggle.tool: Press once to raise the shield, press again to lower it.
holdshield.config.messages.tooltip: Show a message above the hotbar when no usable shield is found or the totem protection stops the shield.
holdshield.config.debug.tooltip: Log every swap and restore decision to the game log. Turn on when reporting a bug.
holdshield.config.priority.tooltip: Which shield to use when you carry more than one. A usable shield already in the hand is always used first.
holdshield.config.priority.highest_durab: Prefer the shield with the most durability left (default).
holdshield.config.priority.lowest_durabi: Prefer the shield with the least durability left, so worn shields get used up first.
Prefer shields in the hotbar over the main inventory (most durability breaks ties).
holdshield.config.priority.inventory_fir: Prefer shields in the main inventory over the hotbar (most durability breaks ties).
holdshield.config.priority.first_found.t: Take the first shield found, hotbar then inventory. Simple and fast; durability is ignored.
holdshield.config.min_durability.tooltip:
Never use a shield with less durability left than this percentage.
Whole number from 0 to 100. 0 = use any shield.
holdshield.config.low_warning.tooltip:
Show a warning above the hotbar when the raised shield has this percentage of durability or less (once per raise).
Whole number from 0 to 100. 0 = off.
holdshield.config.hand.offhand.tooltip: The shield goes into the offhand; your main hand item stays where it is (default).
holdshield.config.hand.main_hand.tooltip: The shield is selected in, or swapped into, your selected hotbar slot. If that slot is empty and the shield comes from the inventory, the shield stays in that slot afterwards.
holdshield.config.totem.tooltip: What to do when your offhand holds a Totem of Undying (only for the Left hand).
holdshield.config.totem.off.tooltip: Swap the totem out like any other item while the shield is up (default).
holdshield.config.totem.use_main_hand.to: Raise the shield with the main hand instead, so the totem stays in the offhand.
holdshield.config.totem.dont_raise.toolt: Do not raise the shield while the totem is in the offhand.
holdshield.config.delay.tooltip:
Delay before raising the shield after equipping.
Set to 0 for instant raise.
Set to 1 if you use Punchy! or other mods that need a short delay.
Higher values help if the shield sometimes fails to raise.
Whole number from 0 to 20 (20 ticks = 1 second).
holdshield.message.totem: Totem in offhand: shield not raised
